Job Description Summary
As a Mechanical Design Engineer you will design turbine hardware for commercial engines.

Roles and Responsibilities
- Develop CATIA V5 models and drawings for turbine hardware
- Perform heat transfer analysis and structural analysis

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering from an accredited university
- Minimum of 3 years of experience with CAD (CATIA or NX)

Desired Characteristics
- Experience with ANSYS Workbench
- Lean manufacturing and Six Sigma knowledge
- Strong technical writing skills

Additional Information
Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes
